name: What is the cost range for replacing flooring in an older home?

mainEntity.name: What is the cost range for replacing flooring in an older home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Flooring replacement costs for older homes vary significantly based on material, labor, and necessary subfloor preparation. Budget-friendly options like laminate or vinyl plank might start lower per square foot, while high-quality hardwood or intricate tile work will be more expensive. Older homes often incur additional costs for subfloor leveling or abatement of old materials like asbestos. It is essential to get a detailed estimate that includes all potential preparation work specific to your home's age and condition.
